caption:
# GUI Interface Description

## System Top Bar
- **Left Side**:
  - "Activities" button
  - "Files" button
- **Center**:
  - Date and time: "Oct 22 23:54"
- **Right Side**:
  - Notification bell icon
  - System status icons (network, sound, power)

## Desktop Background
- Abstract geometric wallpaper with gradient of purple to red hues
- Visual elements resembling flowing, layered fabric or feathers

## Left Sidebar (Dock)
- **Application Icons (Top to Bottom)**:
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird email client
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC media player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP image editor
  - File manager (folder icon)
  - Ubuntu Software (orange "A" icon)
  - Help icon (blue circle with question mark)
  - Trash icon (recycle bin)
  - Application grid (9-dot icon)

## File Manager Window
- **Window Title**: "Home"
- **Window Controls** (Top Right):
  - Minimize button
  - Maximize button
  - Close button (X)
- **Navigation Bar** (Top):
  - Back button (left arrow)
  - Forward button (right arrow)
  - Home button (house icon)
  - Search icon (magnifying glass)
  - View options (three horizontal lines)
  - View toggle (list view icon)
  - Window control buttons (minimize, maximize, close)
- **Left Sidebar (Navigation Panel)**:
  - "Recent" (clock icon)
  - "Starred" (star icon)
  - "Home" (house icon) - currently selected
  - "Desktop" (folder icon) - tooltip: "Open your personal folder"
  - "Documents" (document icon)
  - "Downloads" (down arrow icon)
  - "Music" (music note icon)
  - "Pictures" (image icon)
  - "Videos" (video camera icon)
  - "Trash" (trash can icon)
  - "Other Locations" (plus sign icon)
- **Main Content Area**:
  - Grid of files and folders
  - **Visible Folders**:
    - Desktop
    - Documents
    - Downloads
    - Music
    - Pictures
    - Public
    - server
    - snap
    - Templates
    - Videos
    - .cache
    - .config
    - .gnupg
    - .ipython
    - .lessht
    - .local
    - .mozilla
    - .pki
    - .profile
    - .selected_editor
    - .ssh
    - .sudo_as_admin_successful
    - thunderbird
    - .var
    - .viminfo
    - .vscode
  - **Visible Files**:
    - requirements.txt
    - .bash_history
    - .bash_logout
    - .bashrc

## Desktop Icons
- **Bottom Right Corner**:
  - "CPD_Background_Inv..." (PowerPoint file icon)
  - "Home" (folder icon)
